title: HackerEarth: Oliver and the Battle (Connected Components)
description: Oliver is in a battle. The battlefield is an M x N grid with 1 representing enemy soldiers and 0 empty ground. Soldiers form a troop if they are connected in 8 directions. Return `[total_troops, max_troop_size]`.
constraints:
1 <= M, N <= 100
• Time: O(M * N) | Space: O(M * N)
explanation: 8-directional DFS visits connected component clusters in O(M*N) time.
